== frame after_list_cd cursor=3,24
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd sub && /bin/pwd
|<HOME>/sub
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/sub $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/sub
== frame after_list_sh cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd sub && /bin/pwd
|<HOME>/sub
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/sub $ cd .. && sh -c 'pwd'
|<HOME>
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/sub
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
